title: Yellow Roasted Kenyan Paneer Curry
description: A rich and creamy Kenyan-inspired curry featuring roasted paneer, perfect for a date night dinner, made with a mortar and pestle for a velvety texture and served on a lazy Susan spinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the paneer into small cubes and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Using a mortar and pestle, pound the onions, garlic, and ginger into a smooth paste.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and add the curry powder, turmeric, and cumin, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Add the pounded onion mixture to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted paneer, coconut milk, salt, and black pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, on a lazy Susan spinner.
